title: TeXcore for Obsidian
description: A minimalistic, high-performance LaTeX assistant for automatic equation numbering, referencing, and client-side TikZ rendering powered by an in-browser WebAssembly TeX engine in Obsidian.md.
highlights: Client-side WebAssembly TeX engine for zero-dependency TikZ compilation in background Web Workers
Auto equation numbering, custom ID tagging, and search-based fuzzy autocomplete via \eqref
Advanced single-note and batch folder PDF export engine with custom typography overrides
